title: NonBillableActivity billing rule body
description: sprk_policyversion.sprk_rulebody shape for sprk_ruletype = NonBillableActivity (ebilling-r1 task 070; spec FR-24, design.md 6.1). 5. The line's activity / task code (AI-assigned, from the resolved code set) is not one of the listed non-billable codes. Parameters only: no rates, timekeepers or code descriptions, and no consequence (that is the sprk_consequence column). additionalProperties=false: any other member is refused, not ignored. 'messageTemplate' (anywhere) and 'then' are refused by RuleBodySchemaValidator before this schema runs.

code.description: A code identifier from the resolved code set (e.g. a UTBMS code such as L110 or E101). The identifier only: descriptions are reference data.
